author: Okkerka
install_msg: Native voice experiment (no Lavalink): unload TidalPlayer and Audio before loading TidalPlayerExp. Restart Red after installing voice dependencies, then run `[p]tidalsetup doctor`. YouTube works without a TIDAL login or API key. For TIDAL, run `[p]tidalsetup login`; experimental settings and login are separate from the original cog. See the cog README for switching and rollback.
name: TidalPlayerExp
short: Native Discord TIDAL and YouTube audio, without Lavalink.
description: Experimental native Discord voice playback using FFmpeg. TIDAL catalog matching with original YouTube audio fallback, lazy source resolution, playlists, Spotify imports, and interactive playback controls. YouTube does not require a TIDAL login or Data API key. Unload Audio and the original TidalPlayer before loading this cog; public command names overlap.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Tidal and Spotify OAuth credentials globally for the bot owner. It does not store data associated with individual Discord users.
